name: ingest-beer-faults
description: Book 6: load the BJCP beer fault list into ref.faults as rows, then generate one card per fault into kb.chunks and embed it. 21 rows, structured path, already-clean source.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO kb.documents (slug, title, doc_type, language, authority)
  VALUES ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
  ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title, doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type,
    language = EXCLUDED.language, authority = EXCLUDED.authority
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO kb.document_versions
  (document_id, version, source_filename, file_sha256, chunker_config, is_current)
SELECT d.id,
       COALESCE((SELECT max(v.version) FROM kb.document_versions v
                 WHERE v.document_id = d.id), 0) + 1,
       'beer_faults.json', $1,
       jsonb_build_object('source','structured','generator','fault-card',
                          'origin','BJCP Beer Fault List, transcribed to beer_faults.json',
                          'note','off-flavour -> remedy only; the source has no cause column'),
       false
FROM d
ON CONFLICT (file_sha256) DO UPDATE
  SET chunker_config = EXCLUDED.chunker_config
RETURNING id AS version_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Doc variant').first().json; return [ $('Crypto').first().json.file_sha256, p.slug, p.title, p.doc_type, p.language, p.authority]; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH demoted AS (
  UPDATE kb.document_versions SET is_current = false
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM kb.chunks
WHERE version_id = (SELECT id FROM demoted)
RETURNING chunk_index;

SELECT c.id, c.content
FROM kb.chunks c
WHERE c.version_id = $1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb.chunk_embeddings e
                  WHERE e.chunk_id = c.id AND e.model = 'bge-m3')
ORDER BY c.chunk_index;

INSERT INTO kb.chunk_embeddings (chunk_id, model, embedding)
VALUES ($1, 'bge-m3', $2::vector)
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id, model) DO UPDATE
  SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, created_at = now()
RETURNING chunk_id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted;

INSERT INTO kb.ingest_log (version_id, stage, level, message, detail)
VALUES ($1::bigint, 'parse', 'info',
        format('loaded %s beer faults: %s descriptors, %s words of remedy text',
               $2::jsonb->>'faults', $2::jsonb->>'descriptors', $2::jsonb->>'solution_words'),
        jsonb_build_object('stats', $2::jsonb,
                           'note','off-flavour -> remedy only; no causes inferred'))
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Ensure KB doc + version').first().json.version_id, JSON.stringify($('Parse + validate faults').first().json.stats)] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ref.faults (name, descriptors, solutions)
SELECT x.name,
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.descriptors)),
       x.solutions
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(name text, descriptors jsonb, solutions text)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET
  descriptors = EXCLUDED.descriptors,
  solutions   = EXCLUDED.solutions
RETURNING id;

-- One card per fault, generated FROM ref.faults so row and card cannot drift.
-- ⛔ No cause line: the source has none (see the table comment).
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT f.name,
         concat_ws(E'\n',
           format('%s — beer fault', f.name),
           'Perceived as: ' || array_to_string(f.descriptors, ', '),
           'Possible solutions: ' || f.solutions
         ) AS body
  FROM ref.faults f
)
INSERT INTO kb.chunks
  (version_id, chunk_index, content, raw_content, heading_path,
   page_from, page_to, token_count, content_sha256)
SELECT $1::bigint,
       (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY name) - 1)::int,
       array_to_string(ARRAY['Beer Faults', name], ' > ') || E'\n' || body,
       body,
       ARRAY['Beer Faults', name],
       NULL::int, NULL::int, NULL::int,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(body, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
FROM parts
ON CONFLICT (version_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET
  content        = EXCLUDED.content,
  raw_content    = EXCLUDED.raw_content,
  heading_path   = EXCLUDED.heading_path,
  content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256
RETURNING chunk_index;
